schema.help: Think of strength, stamina and general health.
schema.text: How would you describe your physical fitness for walking at the moment (strength, stamina, balance)?

ar.#How would you describe your physical fi: كيف تصف لياقتك البدنية الحالية للمشي (القوة، التحمل، التوازن)؟
ar.#Think of strength, stamina and general: فكّر في القوة والتحمل والصحة العامة.

de.#How would you describe your physical fi: Wie würden Sie Ihre derzeitige körperliche Fitness zum Gehen beschreiben (Kraft, Ausdauer, Gleichgewicht)?
de.#Think of strength, stamina and general: Denken Sie an Kraft, Ausdauer und allgemeine Gesundheit.

en.#How would you describe your physical fi: How would you describe your physical fitness for walking at the moment (strength, stamina, balance)?
en.#Think of strength, stamina and general: Think of strength, stamina and general health.

fa.#How would you describe your physical fi: آمادگی جسمانی فعلی خود را برای پیاده‌روی (قدرت، استقامت، تعادل) چگونه توصیف می‌کنید؟
fa.#Think of strength, stamina and general: به توان، استقامت و سلامت عمومی فکر کنید.

fr.#How would you describe your physical fi: Comment décririez-vous actuellement votre condition physique pour marcher (force, endurance, équilibre) ?
fr.#Think of strength, stamina and general: Pensez à la force, à l'endurance et à la santé en général.

hu.#How would you describe your physical fi: Hogyan írná le jelenlegi fizikai erőnlétét a gyalogláshoz (erő, állóképesség, egyensúly)?
hu.#Think of strength, stamina and general: Gondoljon az erejére, a kitartására és az általános egészségi állapotára.

it.#How would you describe your physical fi: Come descriveresti in questo momento la tua forma fisica per camminare (forza, resistenza, equilibrio)?
it.#Think of strength, stamina and general: Pensa a forza, resistenza e salute in generale.

tr.#How would you describe your physical fi: Yürümek için şu anki fiziksel formunuzu nasıl tanımlarsınız (güç, dayanıklılık, denge)?
tr.#Think of strength, stamina and general: Güç, dayanıklılık ve genel sağlığı düşünün.
